# Footer

The `Footer` identify the brand and application, and provide links, navigation and copyright.
See [Footer guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/footer/design/)

<Source code="import { Footer } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />
- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root elements
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Footer/index.ts)
- If you are using `IconButton`, then make sure to use the `ghostNegative` variant to make it visible on the darker background.<br />
- If you are using `Link`, then make sure to use the `Negative` variant to make it visible on the darker background.
## Examples

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={FooterStories.Dark} />

### Secondary links

Secondary content of the footer is free for you to pass anything as children.
In this example we display 4 columns of categorised links, that will layout responsively on smaller screens, with a maximum width of 1440px.

<Canvas of={FooterStories.Secondary} />

### Extended

Social links or any additional content can be displayed in secondary or extended parts of the footer.

<Canvas of={FooterStories.Extended} />

### Back to top

<Canvas of={FooterStories.BackToTop} />

```css
.footer-backtotop {
  height: 3.5rem;
  background: rgb(247, 249, 250);
  padding: 0.5rem;
  text-align: right;
}
```

### Mobile

By default the reponsive variant of the primary links is displayed until `sm` breakpoint.
You can change this by using the `mobileUntil` prop.

<Canvas of={FooterStories.Mobile} />

### Max width

On large screen, we recommend to set a maximum width to the footer content and display margins on the left and right side.
This example limits the width of the footer primary, secondary and extended content to 1440px.

<Canvas of={FooterStories.MaxWidth} />

```css
.footer-maxwidth {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: calc(1440px - 1rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
}
```
